uncertainty.resampling: Enumerate all 6**6 ordered draws with replacement of six paired blocks; identical multiplicity vectors may be aggregated with their multinomial weights. Preserve all event and shutdown observations within every sampled block.
uncertainty.statistic: Log of pooled candidate/reference p95 for lag; log of summed candidate/reference CPU seconds for matched active windows; log of (candidate total cost / candidate total elapsed) / (reference total cost / reference total elapsed) for idle rates; log of pooled p95 seconds for absolute shutdown. Use nearest-rank p95.
uncertainty.one_sided_p_value: (1 + weighted_count(t_star - t <= t - log(limit))) / (1 + resample_count); t is the observed log statistic. This is the null-centered lower-tail test against the registered upper limit.
uncertainty.upper_bound: Basic bootstrap upper bound exp(t - quantile_alpha(t_star - t)); quantiles use the weighted nearest rank. Report nominal alpha=.05 and the threshold-specific Holm step alpha=.05/(family_size-rank+1). A gate passes only if its Holm adjusted p-value is <= .05 and its upper bound is <= its limit.
uncertainty.multiplicity: Holm-Bonferroni over every comparison in comparisons, including failed/unresolved comparisons assigned p=1. Sort ties in configuration order; adjusted p is the running maximum of min(1, (family_size-rank+1)*p).
uncertainty.unresolved_denominator: A reference statistic at or below resolution in the observed sample or any resample makes the comparison unresolved (p=1). Nonpositive candidate statistics are also unresolved; never substitute an epsilon.

selection: Require complete healthy matched runs, a complete baseline, and all active, client CPU, and shutdown gates in both models. Require idle server CPU or byte saving in each model. First take the eligible candidate with the lowest worse idle server CPU ratio across models (shorter wait breaks equal point estimates); select it only if the paired CPU comparison is decisive against every other eligible candidate in both models. Otherwise repeat using worse idle byte ratios and paired byte comparisons. If neither establishes one winner, choose the shortest eligible wait. No qualifying larger candidate retains 1000 ms. Skip a resource ranking if any eligible candidate lacks resolved candidate-to-baseline ratios for that resource in either model.
